## 🚀 Description
This Pull Request introduces a fully functional Authentication System (Login & Registration) and standardizes the repository documentation. 

## 📝 Changes Included
* **Authentication UI:** Added a responsive, modern Login and Registration card interface.
* **Client-Side Auth Logic:** Implemented `localStorage` to save registered users, allowing immediate login without a backend database.
* **Smooth Transitions:** Added seamless toggle functionality between the Login and Register forms without page reloads.
* **Preloader Integration:** Configured the preloader spinner to trigger only after successful authentication before loading the main iframe.
* **Documentation:** Added a comprehensive `README.md` complete with setup instructions, tech stack, and author details.
